title: Restore canonical customer receipt and supplier payment form entry
description: Complete the cash-evidence ends of the core sales/procurement chain through existing canonical finance modules. BILL_CODE_MAP receipt/payment still overrides MODULES configured for api/finance/receipts and api/finance/payments, taking users to legacy writers whose mutation policy intentionally refuses writes. Route these existing authorized menus to canonical modules with canonical IDs; do not enable legacy writes or infer Oid/Id mappings. FinanceReceipt.ReceiptNo and FinancePayment.PaymentNo are Required with empty defaults although controllers allocate them. Restore blank-number HTTP binding while preserving server-owned identity/status, positive currency-safe amounts, source application/sales ownership, live current authority and shared allocation budgets. Forms must retain correct typed nullable references and reach existing allocation registers from saved canonical rows; use existing service paths only, no ledger backfill or automatic financial assignment. Isolated HTTP fixtures generate ephemeral process-local JWT keys and never use production settings. Retain existing live identity/menu/customer-scope authority, transactions, source locks, controlled errors and audit. Reject before numbering or persistence, with zero header/detail/source/status mutations. No new permissions, schema, production access, external service or arbitrary SQL. Genuine SQL only on (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance with Integrated Security and a fresh GUID-owned NEWERP_AUTOTEST database; reject wrong/existing targets and never drop/reset. Require safe Release with analyzers/warnings-as-errors, full units and relevant genuine SQL/browser tests; accurately record blockers and do not claim whole-stage acceptance. Keep every build/test log and TRX under .ai/logs/ERP-479 with explicit --results-directory, never repository-root TestResults. Preserve full original failures; relocate completed artifacts into .ai/logs without deleting work or resetting attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Existing receipt/payment menus select their canonical modules, and genuine authenticated blank-number HTTP create/save/reload/edit returns server-owned canonical ID/number/state. Valid manual receipt/payment and explicitly linked application/order flows remain usable without legacy-ID remapping or expanded permission.

Canonical typed fields reach existing monetary/reference/transaction validators; lifecycle and active shared-budget allocations remain authoritative. Invalid currencies/amounts, stale source, wrong customer/supplier, revoked authority or overallocated funding cause zero evidence, source, budget, status and numbering changes. Saved canonical IDs open existing receipt/payment allocation workspaces.

Meaningful isolated SQL/HTTP and genuine authorized browser workflows prove blank-number model binding, canonical menu routing, round trip, valid lifecycle/allocation and rejected zero-mutation cases; browser absence is recorded rather than replaced by mocked business writes. Preserve existing lifecycle/allocation regressions and pass safe Release/full units.
implementation_evidence: bill-v2.js:29-30 retains receipt/payment legacy dispatch; modules-finance.js already defines api/finance/receipts and api/finance/payments canonical forms but app.js chooses the legacy map first. Finance2.cs:77-78 and Finance1.cs:107-108 mark server-generated ReceiptNo/PaymentNo Required. FinanceReceiptComplaintControllers.Create:72 and FinancePaymentController.Create:80 allocate server numbers after business authority; ERP-349/350/351/378/379 govern lifecycle/capacity rather than primary HTTP/menu entry.
